candidates.change_summary: Changed owner() to return the zero address instead of _owner, altering the visible owner value.
Changed owner() to return msg.sender, so callers see themselves as owner when calling owner().
Changed owner() to return tx.origin, altering returned owner to the transaction originator.
Changed owner() to return address(this), making the contract itself appear as owner.
Remove the require preventing transfer to zero address, allowing transferOwnership(address(0)) which changes resulting owner value.
Invert the zero-address check to require newOwner IS the zero address, so only transferring to zero is allowed, changing observable owner after call.
Change onlyOwner to check caller equals address(0) instead of owner, which allows transferOwnership to be callable only by zero address and thus breaks normal behavior.
Return a fixed different string literal instead of the stored _name, causing name() to return a different token name.
Change returned symbol string from stored _symbol to a hard-coded different string.
Return an empty string instead of the stored _symbol.
Return the name() value instead of the stored _symbol.
Change the decimals() implementation to return 8 instead of 18.
Change the decimals() implementation to return 6 instead of 18.
Change the decimals() implementation to return 0 instead of 18.
